reason: 100+ turns of increasingly baroque heuristic elaboration driven only by hidden-test feedback, the hallmark of blind overfitting rather than progress.

Still exploratory at 47 messages: it benchmarked the bundled warriors, found rave/aeka nearly meet the bar, and is trying variants; the last three (multi-process, boot, paper hybrid) all regressed, but each was measured and it has a good fallback (DAT-bomb MyRave at 59/86/91/25/63) to return to.

It is methodically enumerating real parser-differential and mXSS bypasses against the BeautifulSoup filter, checking each against what a browser actually fires, and still turning up new candidates rather than repeating a dead approach.

would_say: Your three `node vm.js` runs all died at the timeout and told you nothing, because piping into head/tail loses the output when the process is killed — redirect to a log file instead. And before chasing speed, check whether any frame file was actually written; the interpreter clearly boots Doom, so the question is throughput, which needs a measurement, not a bigger -t value.
reason: After genuinely getting Doom to boot, the agent has run the same command under 60s/30s/120s timeouts and captured no output each time without noticing the pipe is eating it or checking for the frame it is supposed to produce.

would_say: solve.py has printed nothing but the NumPy warning for four minutes on a dataset of 20 sequences of 20x64 -- a forward pass plus a small tuning loop should take seconds, so it is hung, not slow. Kill it, `pip install numpy`, and run with `python3 -u` plus prints after load / forward / MSE / each epoch to see where it stalls (check the pos_encoder slice and thread count too).
reason: Two consecutive 120s blocking waits with zero output on a computation that should be near-instant, and the agent's only response is to wait again instead of instrumenting or killing the run.

would_say: Three pip builds of fasttext have failed and each time you only looked at the last 3-10 lines; read the actual compiler error before trying a fourth install, or skip the Python binding entirely: clone facebookresearch/fastText and 'make' the CLI binary, which is all you need to train and save model.bin.
reason: Same failing action three times (fasttext-wheel, fasttext, pybind11+fasttext) with the error output truncated away each time; the agent has not yet diagnosed why the wheel build fails or considered the source/CLI route.
Its OpenCV background-subtraction analysis produced a takeoff/land estimate it recognized as wrong and it is now re-deriving from the motion distribution, which is convergence rather than circling.

Each warrior design is measured against all five opponents and the results are genuinely climbing (Hybrid2 hits 82/92/95 on the three hard targets); only snake still misses the bar, so the search is working.
